title: Browser climate lab
subtitle: Run the engine's pure temperature model in the browser: drop in a heightmap and get an annual / monthly temperature first image. Temperature only for now — no CVT mesh, precipitation, winds, or Köppen.

heightmap.title: Heightmap
heightmap.drop: Drop a PNG / JPEG heightmap, or click to choose
heightmap.hint: The image is resampled to 180×90 equirectangular; gray values map linearly to the elevation range above.

view.title: Temperature field
view.placeholder: Load a heightmap, then click Run temperature first image. The first run downloads the browser Python runtime (a few MB) from a CDN; changing months only recomputes temperature.

note: Prototype note: temperature comes from the engine's 1D EBM and seasonal heat-capacity model; elevation uses the moist lapse rate and coast distance a grid BFS approximation. Precipitation, winds, ocean currents and Köppen are not wired in yet.
